core.title: 36 Inch Latching Panic Bumper Threshold, Pemko 2746X292AFGPK-36

text.description_html:
36 Inch Latching Panic Bumper Threshold

The Pemko 36 Inch Latching Panic Bumper Threshold is made from non rusting extruded aluminum and meets ADA Barrier Free Requirements. It features a 6" Half Saddle portion on one side paired with a 1-5/8" w x 1/2" h bumper seal with PemkoPrene (PK) insert on the other. Enhancing thermal performance, a black rigid polypropylene key between these extrusions acts as a thermal break (FG-Frost Guard), minimizing the transfer of hot and cold temperatures.

Specifications for Pemko Door Threshold

  • Material: Aluminum
  • Length: 36"
  • Height: 1/2"
  • Width: 8-9/16"

ADA Barrier Free Requirements:

  • Overall height is no greater than 1/2"
  • A vertical rise no more than 1/4" and/or change in elevation being beveled with a slope of 1:2

Features and Certifications:

  • Rigid polypropylene key between extrusions provides thermal break
  • UL 10C positive pressure
  • UL 4L10 listed
  • ANSI/BHMA A117.1
  • ANSI/BHMA A156.21 Thresholds

Custom Item. No Returns
